notes: Variant is a standard forearm side plank from the feet. External and internal oblique are primary from direct side-bridge/lateral-plank EMG. Gluteus medius is secondary despite high measured activation because it controls pelvic position rather than being the exercise's main core target. Erector spinae support is based on the longissimus thoracis evidence in side-bridge studies and uses the existing visible spinal-extensor anatomy group. Quadratus lumborum is relevant but not listed because no local mesh mapping exists; no fallback muscle ID was used.
